purpose: Teach: プロテスタント/永住/聖人/女系/震度/上半身/巨匠/社団

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、プロテスタント宗教改革史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on the history of the Protestant Reformation, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. Gentle confirmation rather than interrogation. Steady eye contact. Patient beat before the question mark — giving space for him to respond.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、永住権制度の比較研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote my paper on comparative research in permanent residency systems.
lines.style: Quiet earnestness. Small, careful correction. No defensiveness, just precision. Slight hesitation before the topic, as if he's already thinking about whether she'll find it interesting.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、聖人崇拝の文化人類学を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper dealt with the cultural anthropology of saint veneration, didn't it?
lines.style: Softer tone, genuinely curious. Leans in slightly. The phrasing suggests she's testing whether he'll correct her again, but warmly — like she wants to know what he actually chose.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、女系継承の世界史比較を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my paper was a comparative world history of matrilineal succession.
lines.style: Patient correction again. Slightly less hesitant this time — he's settling into the rhythm. Steady, matter-of-fact delivery. Not apologetic, just clear.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 震度別の建物被害研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your paper examined building damage by earthquake magnitude, right?
lines.style: Engaged and present. Leans forward slightly. The tone shifts — she's testing him, but not unkindly. Curious to see if there's a pattern in his corrections.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ボディビル選手の上半身トレーニングを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually wrote about upper body training methods for competitive bodybuilders.
lines.style: Another quiet correction. The tone is patient but there's a very slight edge of wryness beneath it — he's aware she's testing him. Doesn't mind, but also doesn't smile.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、映画界の巨匠の演出論を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper was on directorial theory in cinema's greatest masters, wasn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, almost playful now. She's enjoying this. Knowing rhythm. Warm beat of anticipation before letting him correct her once more.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、公益社団法人の運営研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my paper focused on operational research of public interest incorporated associations.
lines.style: Final correction arrives gently. A soft landing. He's warmer now, having survived the gauntlet. Slight breath of relief on the trailing phrase — like he knows she was testing him and he passed.
